integrity: The primary full PDF was inspected at Eqs. (2.4)-(2.13), Theorem 2.1, its proof, and Figures 5-6. The proof here starts from the source's actual density rather than its altered logarithm in Eq. (2.8). A standalone high-precision checker was replayed from the packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The complete global log-concavity region in the beta-lambda plane is not classified.
The finding does not reassess quantiles, moments, acceptance sampling, inference, or empirical fits.
Separate heavy-tail prose claims in the source are outside the accepted claim.
title: The EBR log-concavity theorem fails in its claimed parameter region
